$comment: Performance budget for a WooCommerce shop (plan K11, F4c). The CI shop job measures these pages on a site with the shop starter installed (tools/ci/setup-wp.sh with WOOCOMMERCE set, then wp pergel starter install shop), with WP_DEBUG off like a live site: WooCommerce skips its product filter cache while WP_DEBUG is on and writes it again on every view. Same keys as budget.json; limits are the measured values with about 10% headroom. A product page lists related products, and WooCommerce stores them again on every view while a category holds fewer products than the list shows (wc_get_related_products), so those writes are named in writesIgnore. WooCommerce also stores empty product filter data (no ratings yet, an attribute no listed product has) but never reads it back (FilterData::get_cache treats an empty value as a miss), so the shop and category pages count those filters again and write their transients and entry counter on every view until the counter reaches its cap; the writes are ignored and the query limits of those two pages include the recount (docs/DECISIONS.md, F4c-2). The cart block alone brings about 660 KB of WooCommerce scripts. The cart and checkout with items are checked by tests/shop (an empty checkout redirects to the cart).
